messages:
maya: quick flag — saw a spike in provisional (not-yet-confirmed) token rows for some customers after we flipped the new routing failover policy last night
sam: which customers / which policy?
maya: a small subset on EU region, routing policy: "regional_fallback_v2" we rolled at 03:12Z
infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-18T03:12Z applied config regional_fallback_v2 to cluster eu-prod-1
maya: repro summary: start streaming session to hosted, force a fallback to dedicated mid-stream, final confirm comes back from dedicated path but ledger shows two provisional claims sometimes both left uncleared
chris: example logs?
maya: pasted snippet from a repro run:
```
[2026-03-18T03:12:01Z] session=aa7b claim=provisional amount=95 path=hosted node=hosted-09
[2026-03-18T03:12:02Z] session=aa7b route=hosted->dedicated trigger=policy_fallback
[2026-03-18T03:12:02Z] session=aa7b claim=provisional amount=105 path=dedicated node=ded-11
[2026-03-18T03:12:03Z] session=aa7b final_confirm amount=200 path=dedicated
```
maya: expected single provisional (or merged) then one final_confirm that reconciles it atomically but instead we end up with two provisional rows totalling 200 and one final_confirm referencing the dedicated provisional only
sam: sounds like we don't tag the original provisional with a handoff id so ledger reconciliation can't match pre-handoff claim to post-handoff claim
chris: agreed. without a provenance link the nightly reconciliation can't dedupe safely. this becomes worse if a toolcall or truncation event creates additional provisional writes
olivia: does truncation cause partial final_confirms? we saw earlier that truncated toolcall would confirm less than provisioned which left drift
maya: truncation can surface different ways. in the repro above it's pure streaming/no toolcall. toolcalls add extra provisional entries (tool tokens) and sometimes final_confirm comes in two pieces if the client reconnects
sam: concrete proposal:
- router emits a handoff_tag (uuid) when it migrates a session across tiers
- annotate both provisional writes with handoff_tag=... so ledger can merge/attribute at confirm time
- add non-destructive nightly job that finds provisional clusters by (session_id OR handoff_tag OR customer+time) and marks orphans for manual review
chris: telemetry plan: create metrics: billing.provisional.handoff.total, billing.provisional.handoff.orphaned, labels={from_tier,to_tier,customer_id,has_toolcall}
maya: dashboard changes: show a "handoff drift" widget on billing health with drilldown to sample session ids and raw ledger rows
olivia: sketch SQL for dashboard drilldown:
```
SELECT customer_id, from_tier, to_tier, count(*) AS handoffs, sum(orphan_amt) AS orphaned_tokens
FROM billing.provisionals
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY customer_id, from_tier, to_tier
ORDER BY orphaned_tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
chris: rollout/phasing constraints: do NOT change final accounting semantics mid-billing-cycle. telemetry + non-destructive metadata first, reconciliation opt-in, auto-merge behind feature flag
sam: impl owners: I'll add handoff_tag emission in router (2d). chris, can you accept handoff_tag in ledger writes and emit the orphan metric (3d)? olivia can you add dashboard tile (1d) and maya will coordinate QA with small customer set
maya: ETA: router PR by EOD Fri, ledger + metrics PR early next week, nightly reconcile job in 2w for opt-in sync
jamie: heard — sounds good. i'll prep a customer-facing note template and coordinate opt-in pilot with 3 customers. agree on telemetry-first approach
chris: edge behavior to confirm: when final_confirm arrives referencing the post-handoff claim, ledger should either 1) atomically merge amounts if handoff_tag links exist OR 2) mark the pre-handoff provisional as superseded so nightly job can reconcile. we'll implement 2) initially (safer) and 1) later behind flag
maya: one more ask: add an alert if orphaned_tokens across all customers > 1% of weekly provisioned tokens so SRE/finance can triage quickly
sam: will add alert rule to pager duty channel + internal dashboard
olivia: i'll add a small red badge on customer billing page if any orphaned_tokens > 0 with link to sample sessions (read-only)
chris: also capture if there's interleaving toolcall provisional rows, label has_toolcall=true in metrics - that helps prioritize customers who hit toolcall-heavy workloads
maya: thank you. creating an RFC and linking to incident playbook. ping here when PRs are opened :thumbsup:
